body:
Detector side of `mimic-anycontext`, run without an LLM because Hugging Face was unreachable (403) and torch was absent. N-gram detector: mean AUROC 0.934 on unseen families vs 0.985 in-family; 40 target items close most of the gap on recipes. Stylised; prompt-optimising imitator not tested. README, site entry, tests (5) and `site/build.py` ok.
